blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) has reminded government agencies to exercise “judicious and prudent” use of public funds in conducting year-end celebrations and other events, citing the pressures being felt by Filipino households from the energy crisis and mounting El Niño.
